summary: Bounded negative reproducibility result: the fresh attempt initially contained only the research brief, so the exact three-declaration source and pinned offline Lean and Mathlib closure were not materially delivered and the requested two-build replay could not begin.

It changes only the attempt-specific observed inventory and brief digest, and contradicts no mathematical, compiler, declaration, axiom, or replay result.
value_assessment.evidence: An initial hidden-inclusive inventory observed exactly one ordinary entry and no directory or link. A direct filesystem enumeration, root attribute check, alternate-stream check, cryptographic digest, and bounded embedded-payload indicator scan independently supported the same absence finding; the final structured records passed local parse and exact-field validation.
value_assessment.falsifier: The scoped result is overturned by exhibiting, within the initial delivered attempt state, attributable exact declaration bytes plus explicit Lean and Mathlib revision pins and every file needed for a network-free build.

claims.statement: In the initial observable state of this attempt, the research brief was the only supplied filesystem entry, so the exact attributable three-declaration source was absent and the ordered replay protocol could not start.
claims.evidence_summary: The hidden-inclusive initial inventory returned one ordinary file and no directory or link; independent filesystem, stream, digest, and content-indicator checks found no separate or embedded material payload.
claims.verification_method: Repeat the hidden-inclusive root inventory, compute the supplied brief's SHA-256, inspect root and stream metadata, and scan the complete brief for source, project, revision-pin, digest, and encoded-archive indicators.

limitations: No exact declaration name, type, source attribution, or expected axiom set was supplied.
No Lean or Mathlib revision was available to record, and no build or axiom inspection was possible.
The content checks do not exclude every conceivable steganographic encoding, but no materially attributable usable source or offline closure is present.
This filesystem result has no implication for the Riemann Hypothesis.
failed_approaches: The preferred search executable was denied execution, so its file-inventory cross-check was replaced by direct filesystem enumeration.
The two clean builds and three axiom reports were not attempted because the exact source, revision pins, project metadata, and dependencies are absent.
next_actions: Materially deliver the exact three-declaration source, exact expected types and axiom sets, explicit revision pins, digest manifest, project metadata, and complete offline dependency closure before replay.
